editorial: When a Kansas highway patrol officer is forced to chase her own death, you are pulled onto a midnight ride through a mind that grows darker with each mile. The film walks you along real highways and into streets where the killer’s signature is etched in traffic lights, blending crime‑scene nuance with psychological depth. Emma Stone gives a close‑shut‑up performance that drips with silent rage—each eye flicker weighing a lifetime of unanswered questions. Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who relish a narrative that lingers on tension longer than its reveal. The pacing takes a slump after the midpoint, allowing the suspense to trail off into an almost leisurely investigation.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who relish narratives that linger on tension.
